It records low measured poverty and income context, but also a fragile recovery marked by property weakness, high debt, weak confidence, aging, and soft global demand.","supporting_evidence_ids":["E035","E040","E081"],"contrary_or_qualifying_evidence_ids":["E035","E040","E081"],"limitations_and_gaps":["No ruler-attributed legislative, budgetary, or implementation evidence is supplied.","The poverty measure is near-period context and does not establish distribution or policy attribution."]},{"question_id":"5B.2","answer":"The packet does not address appointments, qualifications, selection processes, operational independence, or performance-based retention and replacement of economic professionals.","supporting_evidence_ids":[],"contrary_or_qualifying_evidence_ids":[],"limitations_and_gaps":["No personnel or institutional-independence evidence is supplied."]},{"question_id":"5B.3","answer":"The packet does not establish whether Xi enacted, administered, or complied with credible fiscal, tax, debt, monetary, or financial rules. It does establish macroeconomic risks including high debt and property-sector weakness, but not their ruler attribution or the quality of the governing response.","supporting_evidence_ids":["E039","E040","E081"],"contrary_or_qualifying_evidence_ids":["E034","E039","E040"],"limitations_and_gaps":["The evidence is outcome and assessment evidence, not direct evidence of rules, administration, or compliance.","The IMF and World Bank assessments do not by themselves attribute the risks or responses to the ruler."]},{"question_id":"5B.4","answer":"The packet does not establish whether Xi created or consistently enforced fair rules for competition, entrepreneurship, property, trade, investment, or job creation.","supporting_evidence_ids":["E036","E037","E038"],"contrary_or_qualifying_evidence_ids":["E036","E037","E038"],"limitations_and_gaps":["Employment statistics provide labor-market context but no evidence about the legal or regulatory regime or its enforcement."]},{"question_id":"5B.5","answer":"The packet contains no evidence sufficient to assess enforcement against politically connected actors, procurement and disclosure rules, anti-corruption enforcement, cooperation with audits or courts, or remedies for favoritism and capture.","supporting_evidence_ids":[],"contrary_or_qualifying_evidence_ids":["E040","E081"],"limitations_and_gaps":["Property weakness and high debt are not evidence of capture and should not be converted into that claim.","No conduct, audit, court, procurement, or ownership evidence is supplied."]},{"question_id":"5B.6","answer":"The packet does not establish whether enacted and executed budgets produced timely, high-quality infrastructure, education, health, technology, administrative capacity, or predictable regulation. The World Bank record notes public infrastructure stimulus and manufacturing investment, but the packet does not provide sufficient implementation or quality evidence to attribute those results to the ruler.","supporting_evidence_ids":["E040"],"contrary_or_qualifying_evidence_ids":["E040"],"limitations_and_gaps":["The evidence records policy support and stimulus at a high level, not executed budgets, delivery quality, or sectoral outcomes.","E040 is a single World Bank assessment and does not settle attribution or durability."]},{"question_id":"5B.7","answer":"The packet records official GDP, unemployment, and growth-target statements, while independent IMF and World Bank assessments identify fragility and structural risks. It does not establish whether the ruler permitted independent evaluation and audit or corrected policies and implementers when evidence showed failure.","supporting_evidence_ids":["E034","E036","E037","E038","E039","E040"],"contrary_or_qualifying_evidence_ids":["E034","E036","E037","E038","E039","E040"],"limitations_and_gaps":["Official reporting and external assessments provide information but not evidence of ruler conduct in disclosure, audit access, or correction.","No direct evidence of policy revision, denial, scapegoating, or remedial implementation is supplied."]},{"question_id":"5B.8","answer":"The packet does not establish whether tax, labor, wage, benefit, investment, or regional policies distributed gains and burdens fairly. It records very low poverty at the World Bank’s $3/day threshold and substantial youth unemployment, but these are incomplete distributional indicators and are not ruler-attributed.","supporting_evidence_ids":["E035","E036","E037","E038"],"contrary_or_qualifying_evidence_ids":["E035","E036","E037","E038"],"limitations_and_gaps":["No incidence data by class, region, gender, or group is supplied.","The poverty threshold does not resolve inequality, housing stress, or local hardship, as the evidence limitation notes."]},{"question_id":"5B.9","answer":"The packet does not establish whether Xi used timely, funded, transparently targeted, monitored, and corrected measures during 2023’s economic pressures. It records recovery and policy support alongside property weakness, high debt, weak confidence, and elevated youth unemployment.","supporting_evidence_ids":["E036","E037","E038","E039","E040"],"contrary_or_qualifying_evidence_ids":["E039","E040"],"limitations_and_gaps":["No specific shock-response measures, funding, targeting, monitoring, correction, or ruler attribution are supplied.","The packet does not distinguish inherited conditions from ruler-controlled responses."]},{"question_id":"5B.10","answer":"The packet cannot determine whether Xi left a stronger and more durable economic trajectory than he inherited. confidence, aging, and soft external
